verdict.rationale: The only documented multi-item mutation is that recording a deployment automatically marks all unresolved errors as resolved. A deploy can be recorded programmatically via the deploy API or `honeybadger deploy` CLI, so this is a real but narrow bulk action. The rest of the evidence covers search, listing faults and per-error resolve buttons, which are reads or single-item actions and don't count as bulk operations. Missing for 10: general bulk actions on selected items (resolve, assign, ignore, delete) in the UI, API or MCP; bulk API endpoints; independent or hands-on corroboration.
